intro-01.text: A fund wants to buy a large block, quietly.

intro-02.text: First, a risk officer approves a mandate: the dealers, the size, the maximum price.

intro-03.text: The agent cannot trade past it. The ledger says no.

intro-04.text: Two dealers quote blind. Neither sees the other's price.

intro-05.text: The lowest price wins, by a rule anyone can check.

intro-06.text: Securities and cash move together, in one transaction, or not at all.

intro-07.text: Every number on screen comes from the ledger.

intro-08.text: Shadow Desk. Approve. Quote. Award. Settle. Private execution, on Canton.
